title: Maintenance Visit Entitlements by Tier (Comfort Club)
content:
Every Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements tier grants precision tune-up visits for each enrolled system and, on the upper tiers, whole-home visits. The entitlements per term are:

| Tier | Tune-up visits per enrolled system per term | Whole-home visits per term | Standard 1-inch filters included per tune-up | Condensate drain treatment in the cooling tune-up | Indoor air quality inspection in each tune-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 1 | 0 | 0 | No | No |
| Comfort Club Silver | 2 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No |
| Comfort Club Gold | 2 | 0 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 2 | 1 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 2 | 1 | 1 | Yes | Yes |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 2 | 2 | 1 | Yes | Yes |

## Seasonal windows and spacing (identical on all six tiers)

| Item | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Cooling season window (month-day) | 03-01 to 06-30 |
| Heating season window (month-day) | 09-01 to 12-15 |
| Minimum calendar days between two tune-ups on the same system | 60 |

## Notes on the entitlements

- **Whole-home visits** (water heater flush, attic and duct inspection, indoor air quality check) are granted per term regardless of how many systems are enrolled; tune-up visits are granted per enrolled system.
- **Filters** are standard 1-inch filters replaced at no charge on each tune-up.
- The cooling and heating windows are month-day windows that recur each year.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical agreement)
A hypothetical Comfort Club Platinum agreement with two enrolled systems receives, per term, 2 tune-up visits for each of the two systems (4 tune-up visits) and 1 whole-home visit. The same two systems on Comfort Club Basic would receive 1 tune-up visit each and no whole-home visit.
